landing.hero_subtitle: Access enterprise-grade data center computing power through NFT technology. No noisy equipment, no maintenance headaches, and daily BTC rewards credited directly to your account.
landing.how_it_works_sub: Start mining Bitcoin in 3 simple steps without buying or maintaining hardware.
landing.step_1_desc: Sign up with your email address. No lengthy paperwork or physical hardware required to start your digital farm.
landing.step_2_desc: Select the hashrate power you want starting from 1.12 TH/s. Every miner is backed by real Bitcoin mining hardware.
landing.step_3_desc: Your rigs mine continuously 24/7. Rewards are deposited daily directly to your balance or Web3 wallet.
landing.catalog_sub: Models configured with the highest energy efficiency on the market. Pick your plan and start mining.
landing.calc_title: How much can you earn mining Bitcoin?
landing.calc_desc: Calculate projections for daily, monthly, and yearly gross income based on real network difficulty and Bitcoin price.
landing.feat_sub: GoMining eliminates all entry barriers of traditional mining.
landing.feat_1_title: No heat or noise at home
landing.feat_1_desc: Industrial ASICs generate deafening noise and consume thousands of watts. At GoMining, rigs operate in top-tier industrial facilities.
landing.feat_2_desc: Share your invite link and earn an instant 10% direct commission on every miner your contacts acquire.
landing.feat_3_desc: Connect MetaMask, Phantom, Trust Wallet, Solflare or Coinbase. Pay and manage assets with leading networks and cryptocurrencies.
landing.feat_4_desc: Your digital miners are NFTs on blockchain. You can upgrade power, boost energy efficiency, or sell them at any time.
landing.feat_5_desc: Data centers powered by renewable and hydroelectric energy to maximize profitability and minimize carbon footprint.
landing.feat_6_desc: Participate in ecosystem decisions, unlock extra service fee discounts, and amplify your rewards.
landing.cta_title: Start your digital mining farm today
landing.cta_desc: Join thousands of global users already generating Bitcoin every day transparently, reliably, and without hardware headaches.
